records.deidentified_narrative: police responded to the above listed location for reports of a motor vehicle vs. pedestrian accident in the parking lot. when i arrived on scene, security officers for the nearby businesses directed me towards the west end of the parking lot. i was pointed in the direction of unit 2 (u2) and unit 3 (u3) who were both on the ground. u2 was in and out of consciousness. u3 was alert and had a visibly broken arm. u2 and u3 seemed very disoriented and did not know what had happened. i was able to locate and contact 2 uninvolved witnesses to the accident. (witness information listed on the keycard and in the afr fsra report.)i was informed by witness # 1 that u2 and u3 were walking on the west side of the building with witness # 1 when unit 1 (u1) pulled up alongside them and stopped. the driver of unit 1 rolled down the driver window and proceeded to ask u2 and u3 if they had a cigarette they could spare. u2 and u3 advised the driver of u1 that they did not have any cigarettes. u2 and u3 both continued walking through the parking lot, away from u1. witness # 1 stated that a few seconds later, he observed u1 strike both u2 and u3, causing serious bodily injury to both of them. u1 driver then fled the location, leaving the parking lot and [roadway] [roadway] 1604 w, without providing any information or stopping to check on the welfare of u2 and u3. the information given by witnesses at the scene was vague regarding the description of u1. the witnesses were unable to provide a license plate number for u1, but both stated that it was a white suv, possibly a lincoln. safd ems arrived on [medical facility] to be treated for their injuries. u2 had a visibly broken left arm, while u3 had visible head trauma and contusions. i contacted tid and spoke with det windsor, g # 2039. i was informed they would not be making the scene due to being tied up handling a different fatality accident. det windsor advised to have the scene processed by a csi and to send him a copy of the reports. csi ballew, m # 2075 arrived at the listed location and processed the scene.

records.deidentified_narrative: aaron stated [roadway]. while traveling on [roadway] when a black ford sedan did not stop behind the stop sign and pulled out in front of him. aaron stated he struck the right side of the ford at the front corner. aaron said he is not sure if there was damage to the ford. aaron said he specifically remembers the ford emblem as he was falling to the ground. aaron said that he felt like both may have been doing 5 to 6 mph at the time of impact. aaron said he fell to the ground and upon impact skinned his right knee, right hand, bloody nose, hurt his right wrist from bracing his fall and skinned up the palm of his left hand. aaron said he laid his head on the grass and the car drove off. aaron stated the driver of the ford never got out to see if aaron needed medical assistance. the ford drove off a few seconds after aaron landed on the ground. paramedics checked him out and released him to his sister who showed up on scene. the unknown driver failed to return to the accident, call dispatch to report the accident, or remain on scene until medical help arrived. the unknown driver also failed to give any identifying information or insurance information. there is no other information on the vehicle or the driver at this time. the driver may live off eastlanddr. or in that immediate area. i was unable to locate the vehicle before or after the accident.
